reasons.correctness: The derived query findByStatusAndResolvedTimeBefore, the transactional closeStaleResolvedTickets returning a count, and the cron job's enabled/days/cron properties with defaults match the interface. The disabled path and the swallowed failure are implemented. Hidden tests 4/4, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: The cron job has @SchedulerLock named support:staleTicketClose. Its cron comes from ${...} and enabled from @Value with default true. It uses @RequiredArgsConstructor with a final field and the *CronJob name. The new StaleTicketCloseCronJobUnitTest uses MockitoExtension. No changeset or i18n was needed.
reasons.design_fit: Logic sits in the service and the query in a derived repository method. The job only delegates and logs. The job lives in support/ticket/services, as the interface requires. No new mechanism, minimal footprint, no unrelated edits.
reasons.test_quality: The tests cover the service happy path, the empty result, the disabled job and the swallowed exception. The cutoff is matched with any(LocalDateTime), so the days-to-cutoff calculation is not pinned. The exception test only verifies the call. LENIENT strictness weakens the stubs.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package files and all *CronJob classes before any edit. That led to reading AnonymousConsentCleanupCronJob and TrialExpiryNotifierCronJob as examples, which the new job follows. Test files were then found with find/grep.
